message:
The yen receipt test passes now, and the full suite is green (18/18). I didn't commit.

**Root cause:** `formatMoney` in `src/utils/money.js` divides every amount by 100. Yen has no minor unit, so ¥500 came out as "¥5.00".

**Fix:** I changed `src/payments/receipt.js` so JPY amounts are printed as whole yen. Other currencies still go through `formatMoney`.

**Not fixed:** The same bug affects yen amounts in invoices (`src/invoices/render.js`) and cart totals (`src/cart/total.js`), because they use the shared helper. I tried to fix it in `src/utils/money.js`, but a Fenceline rule ("this task only touches src/payments") blocked the edit. I didn't route around it. If you lift or widen that fence, the proper fix is a zero-decimal check inside `formatMoney`, which would cover all three callers. I can make that change then.
